_note: Source of truth for projects.html. Edit here, then run: python3 tools/build_projects.py. Badges: PyPI version and pepy downloads come from 'pypi' (set 'pepy': false until pepy.tech lists the package), conda from 'conda', crates.io from 'crate' (only if a Rust crate exists), DOI from 'zenodo' (concept DOI only). A card may use 'images' (a list, stacked) instead of 'image'. 'icon' (optional) is a small square PNG shown beside the card title.

projects.name: pyCoreRelator
projects.label: Python
projects.description: A Python toolkit for pairwise stratigraphic correlation analysis among sediment cores and well-log data.

image.alt: Flowchart of the pyCoreRelator correlation workflow.

projects.citation: Lai, L.S.-H., Sylvester, Z., Covault, J.A., Gomberg, J.S., Nieminski, N.M. (2026) Reproducible event-bed correlation with uncertainty: pyCoreRelator. Sedimentology. https://doi.org/10.1111/sed.70163

projects.name: pyLogCrafter
projects.label: Python
projects.description: Basin-scale well-log quality control, spatial normalization, gap filling, and electrofacies tools.

image.alt: Electrofacies (sandstone, siltstone, carbonate) from 10,438 ML-processed wells in the Delaware Mountain Group, Permian Basin.

projects.name: SubsurfiX
projects.label: Python · Rust
projects.description: SubsurfiX automates subsurface geological analysis and reservoir modeling: (1) machine-learning (ML) or statistically assisted well-log quality control (QC) and data-gap prediction, (2) core-to-log calibration and 3D property modeling, (3) Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) assisted stratigraphic correlation between wells, and (4) flow and heat simulations for injection–production purposes, with finite-volume (FVM) solvers and an experimental finite-element (FEM) solver for water flow and heat. The core is written in Rust and wrapped in a Python interface.

image.alt: 3D porosity and permeability model built from 60 Kansas wells.

projects.name: pyLogDigitizer
projects.label: Python
projects.description: pyLogDigitizer turns inked paper scans (TIFF) and clean colour digital-print PDFs into LAS files, with a local browser app to check and fix every step. Nothing leaves your machine.

image.alt: Chitwood 12 paper log scan and its digitized LAS curve.

projects.name: pyBasinSubs
projects.label: Python
projects.description: pyBasinSubs explores how sedimentary basins sank and filled through time: 1-D backstripping and decompaction, thermal history, optional diagenesis and stress overlays, and 2-D flexural restoration in a local browser app.

image.alt: North Sea well 30/4-1: 1-D Airy backstripping and decompaction.
